notes.title: Eternights Development Journey
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yjmNR1N.png[/img]

No word can express my feeling. 

I started developing this game as a solo developer around the middle of 2019 as a hobby while having a full time job. I started working on small gameplay snippets and uploading it to different subreddits. One day, a game investor contacted me for a demo. I didn't have any demo at the time so I had to create something like a 7 min long demo super fast, which eventually turned into a green light for funding. It was not an easy decision for me to leave a full time job but I had to do it. 
In 2021, I was fortunate to get an opportunity to work with Sony PlayStation and make Eternights a console exclusive title.
In Feb 2022, there was an internal demo with 90% of the game being at a pre-alpha quality build. Half of the testers had wet eyes, and one person even cried (She accidentally was recording her voice entire time during the record of gameplay 🙂 This version didn't even have any Voice Acting yet). At that moment, I knew I was closer to achieving what I wanted but I needed more time. So, I asked Sony if we could delay the release date to 2023. 
In June 2022, I was blown away that my title was announced next to FF16, the series I grew up with. To be really honest it was a bittersweet moment. I was happy because I was able to make a project that could be featured in State of Play but sad that there was only so much a solo full-time developer could do. 
September 2023, I'm sharing release debut title, Eternights.
Developing Eternights has been a great journey and I have learned a lot. A LOT.
I hope you all enjoy Eternights and that you'll follow Studio Sai's [b]next steps[/b].

notes.title: Patch Note 9.20.2023
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Note[/h1]

[h3]1) Fixed - Black screen issue on startup[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game won't corrupt the settings.sav anymore.
[*]Please send me the log if you still find your self trouble in this issue -  the logs can be found in 
%localappdata%low\Studio Sai\Eternights\Player.log
[/list]
Workaround for people who currently has the black screen on startup / corrupted settings.sav: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1402110/discussions/0/3873714328952908681/


[h3]2) Fixed - Black screen issue on cutscene for some graphics card
[/h3]
[list]
[*]In the Graphics option, turn on "Video Playtype MP4" for people who had issue with cutscene on June 15.
For others, turn on "Video Playtype WEBM".
[*]Please if A) does not work, please toggle B) instead. if B) does not work, please toggle A) instead.
[*]Please send me(fkkcloud@studiosai.dev) the log if the issue persists.-  the logs can be found in 
%localappdata%low\Studio Sai\Eternights\Player.log
[/list]

[h3]3) Polish - Save/Load UI, UX.
[/h3]
Save and Load UI is not visually distinct to each other to help people who accidentally loaded old progress.


[h3]4) Polish - Platinum achievement unlock[/h3]
Platinum achievement to be checked on every achievement unlock moment instead of trigging at the end of the game once.

notes.title: ETERNIGHTS IS OUT TODAY!
notes.notes:
ETERNIGHTS IS OUT TODAY!

On June 2020, three years ago, I quit my job to start this project. 
I couldn't imagine what developing a game as a solo full time would become. I had to wear all sorts of hats for the last 3 years. I now know how important each and every person/department in the industry is 😂. 
In 2022, I was blown away that my title was announced next to FF16, the series I grew up with. To be really honest it was a bittersweet moment. I was happy because I was able to make a project that could be featured in State of Play but sad that there was only so much a solo full-time developer could do. 
Now, in 2023, I am still (even now) learning how much work goes into each game development hat. 
But starting this August, the people who have helped me make Eternights are joining as full-time employees for the 2nd game. I am happy to say that Studio Sai is no longer a one man studio.

notes.title: Anime action RPG Eternights is like a very horny Persona
notes.notes: Not long after I launch the demo of Eternights, I'm slipped some advice by doltish sideman Chani. "To get girls online you have to be more than a smartass," he says. "You have to be serious." It's not the kind of topic I expect to give much thought to when feral mutants are running amok and humankind's spiritual fate hangs in the balance. But in a game where fighting to save the world with a phantasmal sword is only as important as finding love with a silver tongue, keeping your fictional Tinder profile looking sharp seems as good an idea as any... notes.title: Eternights Spring Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=jr1FHBdluJI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone,

We're delighted to share our brand new Spring Update video with you!

Since our June 2022 reveal, we've made a plethora of updates to [i]Eternights[/i]. To name just a few, one of the the most important aspects we focused on was enhancing the overall gameplay flow and immersion, so players can truly lose themselves in the characters and story of the game.

Outside of that, we have really exciting news about the Japanese voice actors! In the near future, we will announce the Japanese voice actors that have agreed to lend their unique energy and talents to the game. We can’t say much, other than they are [b]well known figures in the anime industry[/b], who have already lent their voices to other [i]beloved[/i] characters.

[i]Eternights [/i]is coming this summer, and we hope that you enjoyed the Spring Update video. The team has worked hard to create a unique and engaging world, and we can't wait for you to dive into the world of [i]Eternights [/i]and experience it for yourself.
